Name: Fix staging deployment by updating expired CI registry token
Description: Staging is broken because the deploy job cannot pull the base image due to an expired registry token. The token was rotated yesterday but the CI secret was not updated. Steps: (1) Regenerate the registry token. (2) Update the CI secret with the new token. (3) Re-run the staging deploy job and confirm it succeeds. Acceptance criteria: Staging deploy job turns green and developers can test again.

Name: Send updated Meridian proposal with new pricing to Lena by end of day

(3) Send the updated proposal to Meridian's procurement contact, Lena, using her email from the kickoff thread. Acceptance criteria: Updated proposal with final pricing is sent to Lena before end of day.
